grammar.pattern: V得 + 程度：歌词中再用
grammar.purpose: Retrieve degree in an imagined scene
grammar.explanation: 唱得慢 describes delivery; 哭得很伤心 describes an acted or imagined emotional degree. A lyrical speaker need not be the writer. Distinguish imagery, performance and actual biography.

examples.py: jué sè kū dé hěn shāng xīn .
zhè yī jù dú dé hěn qīng chǔ .

commonMistakes.wrong: 歌词里的角色哭，作者一定在哭。
commonMistakes.right: 歌词里的角色不一定是作者。
commonMistakes.why: Do not infer biography from a lyrical speaker.

grammar.explanation: 比起昨天，这一句更清楚 compares the specific sentence and times. 比起快，她更重视准确 compares priorities, not a universal speed rule. Name a comparison basis and preserve the claim’s scope.

examples.zh: 比起昨天，这一句更清楚。
examples.py: bǐ qǐ zuó tiān , zhè yī jù gèng qīng chǔ .
examples.en: Compared with yesterday, this sentence is clearer.

examples.py: bǐ qǐ kuài , tā gèng zhòng shì zhǔn què .
examples.en: She values accuracy more than speed.

examples.zh: 比起独自练，她更喜欢一起读。
examples.py: bǐ qǐ dú zì liàn , tā gèng xǐ huān yì qǐ dú .
examples.en: She prefers reading together to practising alone.

commonMistakes.wrong: 这句更清楚说明全部都懂了。
commonMistakes.right: 这句更清楚没有说明全部都懂。
commonMistakes.why: A comparative clarity claim is not total mastery.

dialogue.title: Whose voice is in the verse?
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.

lines.zh: 把两段合起来，按顺序排；重读时别丢意思。
lines.py: bǎ liǎng duàn hé qǐ lái , àn shùn xù pái ; chóng dú shí bié diū yì si .
lines.en: Combine the two passages and arrange them; preserve meaning on rereading.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 她唱得很慢，是作者也很伤心吗？
lines.py: tā chàng dé hěn màn , shì zuò zhě yě hěn shāng xīn ma ?
lines.en: She sings slowly. Is the author sad too?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 不一定，角色和作者不同。比起快，她更重视准确。
lines.py: bù yí dìng , jué sè hé zuò zhě bù tóng . bǐ qǐ kuài , tā gèng zhòng shì zhǔn què .
lines.en: Not necessarily; character and writer differ. She values accuracy above speed.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 划船、烟和武器都是意象，外交和平是愿望吗？
lines.py: huá chuán , yān hé wǔ qì dōu shì yì xiàng , wài jiāo hé píng shì yuàn wàng ma ?
lines.en: Are rowing, smoke and weapons imagery, and diplomatic peace a wish?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 这里是原创诗的想象，不是现实报道；直到最后才说清楚。
lines.py: zhè lǐ shì yuán chuàng shī de xiǎng xiàng , bù shì xiàn shí bào dào ; zhí dào zuì hòu cái shuō qīng chǔ .
lines.en: This is an original verse’s imagination, not a real report; it becomes clear only at the end.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，随自己的节奏读，累了先停止。
lines.py: hǎo , suí zì jǐ de jié zòu dú , lèi le xiān tíng zhǐ .
lines.en: Good; read at your own pace and stop first when tired.
lines.speaker: b

reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.

lines.zh: 语言团把两段组合练习，团结不是每个人都同一种感受。
lines.py: yǔ yán tuán bǎ liǎng duàn zǔ hé liàn xí , tuán jié bù shì měi gè rén dōu tóng yī zhǒng gǎn shòu .
lines.en: The language group practises joined passages; unity does not mean identical feelings.

lines.zh: 节拍带动跟读，管材料的人不代任何人同意；推广以前核对来源。
lines.py: jié pāi dài dòng gēn dú , guǎn cái liào de rén bù dài rèn hé rén tóng yì ; tuī guǎng yǐ qián hé duì lái yuán .
lines.en: The beat prompts reading along; the materials manager does not consent for others; check sources before promotion.

lines.zh: 故事里角色前进，追着影子，争第一也要尊重别人，争取机会不等于得到。
lines.py: gù shì lǐ jué sè qián jìn , zhuī zhe yǐng zi , zhēng dì yī yě yào zūn zhòng bié ren , zhēng qǔ jī huì bù děng yú dé dào .
lines.en: The character moves forward and chases shadows; competing for first requires respect; striving is not obtaining.

lines.zh: 桌上有汤、果汁、香蕉和苹果，旁边的龙玩具只是道具。
lines.py: zhuō shàng yǒu tāng , guǒ zhī , xiāng jiāo hé píng guǒ , páng biān de lóng wán jù zhǐ shì dào jù .
lines.en: The table has soup, juice, bananas and apples; the dragon toy nearby is only a prop.

lines.zh: 伟大是评价，和平是愿望；直到最后才回答，不说明从最后才开始等。
lines.py: wěi dà shì píng jià , hé píng shì yuàn wàng ; zhí dào zuì hòu cái huí dá , bù shuō míng cóng zuì hòu cái kāi shǐ děng .
lines.en: Great is an evaluation and peace a wish; answering only at the end does not mean waiting starts there.
